headings.usage: Use for all main headers (H1-H3). Radical weight contrast (Black vs Light). Never use 'Inter'. Tight letter spacing: `tracking-tight`.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, list items, and standard UI elements. High legibility for document reading.

mono.usage: Use for code snippets, citations, timestamps, and metadata.

rules: Use stark monochrome backgrounds with single high-contrast primary accents.
Never use pure black #000000 or generic gray. Always tint neutrally (e.g., #050505).
Limit the use of primary colors to CTAs, active states, and AI generation highlights.
Green (Accent) is used strictly for privacy indicators, encryption status, and successful citations.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_knowledge_base: High Density Grid. Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized for document lists and upload status. Strict hierarchical grids.
grids_and_layouts.chat_interface: Tri-pane layout: 1) Collapsible Left History Rail, 2) Centered Chat Transcript (max-width for readability), 3) Right Artifact/Citation Panel for displaying source documents and metadata.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing Philosophy for landing pages (p-12, p-24). Compact, dense spacing for the knowledge base (p-4, p-6).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Always left-align chat inputs, document titles, and paragraphs. Avoid centering text unless in an empty state.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton for the knowledge base. Use 1px subtle borders (border-border/40).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Optical Clarity' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80) for sticky headers and floating context menus.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or subtle inner glows. Use neo-brutalist contrast where appropriate.

motion.chat_streaming: Token-by-token output with a visible stop button and typing states. Add a subtle shimmer to generating text.
motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly change background and text color (e.g., hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground). Focus states must have higher contrast.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease). NEVER use 'transition: all'.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Minimum 3:1 for interactive elements.
accessibility.focus: Clear, high-contrast focus rings for all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-document-button').

components.forms_inputs: Use customized Shadcn UI components. Never use native inputs.
components.buttons: Sharp edges or extremely subtle rounding (max 4px radius). Hover state should lift slightly or invert colors.
components.chat_bubbles: Avoid traditional bubble shapes. Use full-width tool framing with subtle background shading for AI responses, transparent background for user prompts.
components.citations: Render citations as small, clickable inline tags that open the right Artifact Panel.
components.toasts: Use 'sonner' for all notifications (e.g., 'Document chunking complete').

image_urls.instruction: Use for the Auth page or Landing page hero section to communicate security.
Use as a decorative background for the empty state of the knowledge base or chat.

image_urls.instruction: Use in the landing page section highlighting data privacy and local vector databases.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboards and tool-heavy interfaces.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required font families: Cabinet Grotesk (headings), IBM Plex Sans (body), IBM Plex Mono.
Implement both Light and Dark modes. Default to Dark mode.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Rely on Shadcn.
Chat interface MUST feature a Left History Rail, a Centered Transcript, and a Right Artifact Panel for citations.
Ensure 'Privacy & Encryption' indicators are visible in the Knowledge Base dashboard.
Do not apply global 'text-align: center' in App.css. Left-align text for readability.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Never use generic placeholder URLs for images.
